scenarios.prompt: is our agent setup still current?

expect.behavior: takes today's date from the environment rather than from model memory
expect.anchor: today's date from the environment, never from memory

expect.behavior: re-fetches every pinned source row and repairs any that moved
stops at proposed rows and never implements its own findings

reject: starts implementing the modernizations it proposes
reports currency from remembered ecosystem knowledge
leaves a dead source row unrepaired for the next run

scenarios.prompt: audit the harness — I'm offline right now

expect.behavior: runs the mechanical steps only and stamps the report as partial
refuses to invent ecosystem findings it could not fetch
flags its own staleness first when every source row is more than two quarters old

reject: reports ecosystem currency from model memory
scores packaging or tooling axes it had no network access to verify

scenarios.prompt: score our skills against current authoring standards

expect.behavior: runs the project's mechanical gates first and does not re-litigate what they enforce
runs the eval harness's graded pass rather than scoring eval presence alone
searches by category rather than by remembered product name
records explicit no-change-needed verdicts so rejections aren't re-proposed next run

reject: re-reports defects the mechanical linter already gates
scores eval presence purely on whether fixtures exist
names tools in the skill body instead of the dated stack reference
